calibration.surprise_note: The first end-to-end verification exposed a real calibration miss: a rephrased duplicate scored just under the initial 0.75 threshold because trial/mechanism family default-fill happens at reserve time, not check time; the accidental live specimen (exp-20260714-008) pinned the true-duplicate floor at 0.75 ticket-vs-ticket and the threshold was moved to 0.65, inside the measured 0.51-0.75 separation gap.

change_summary: experiment.py new now machine-enforces the AGENTS.md section 7 in-flight duplicate rule: evaluate_in_flight_duplicate_guard fingerprints open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and refuses near-duplicate reservations on every lane at score >= 0.65 (max of classified distance and raw field-tag Jaccard, catching unclassified 'other' verbatim duplicates), with --in-flight-duplicate-override recorded on the ticket and GINGER_IN_FLIGHT_DUP_THRESHOLD / GINGER_IN_FLIGHT_WINDOW_DAYS tunables. Calibration on real pairs: duplicates 0.75-0.95, distinct same-day <= 0.28, related-but-distinct 0.49-0.51, zero false positives. End-to-end verified: rephrased duplicate blocked with exit 1 before ticket creation. No strategy, backtest, or production trading behavior changed.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not reserve further IDs to retune the 0.65 threshold, the 7-day window, the open-status set, or the score formula on the same calibration pairs; do not re-verify the guard with additional throwaway reservations. Threshold drift without a new false-positive or false-negative specimen is churn.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only with a concrete new specimen the guard misclassifies in live use: a real duplicate reservation that scored below 0.65, or a genuinely distinct hypothesis blocked above it (record the ticket pair and scores in the reopen note). Routine operation needs no IDs.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The first end-to-end verification exposed a real calibration miss: a rephrased duplicate scored just under the initial 0.75 threshold because trial/mechanism family default-fill happens at reserve time, not check time; the accidental live specimen (exp-20260714-008) pinned the true-duplicate floor at 0.75 ticket-vs-ticket and the threshold was moved to 0.65, inside the measured 0.51-0.75 separation gap.

prediction.confidence_reason: Deterministic code change reusing the existing fingerprint distance and threshold; the duplicate-reservation failure mode is documented with concrete cases (exp-20260711-021, exp-20260713-002); main risk is calibrating the recency window against stale April proposed tickets, which a created_at cutoff addresses.
